tools.name: read_collection
tools.description: Read one collection by its numeric ID, the number in the collection URL after /collection/. Raindrop documents this route in the singular and wraps it in an item object. No bookmark is created or changed.

tools.name: list_root_collections
tools.description: Read the account's root collections. Raindrop returns whole collection objects in one response and this profile does not follow paging; a result document with result false is not a collection list and the read fails.
